description:
A suspicious host has been identified in the email traffic capture 'smtp.pcap'. 

1. Open '~/Documents/captures/smtp.pcap' in Wireshark.
2. Identify the Client IP address (the sender of the HELO/EHLO command).
3. Use 'Tools > Firewall ACL Rules' to generate a 'Cisco IOS (standard access list)' rule to DENY traffic from this IP. Save it to '~/Documents/cisco_block_rule.txt'.
4. Use the same tool to generate a 'Netfilter (iptables)' rule to DENY traffic from this IP. Save it to '~/Documents/iptables_block_rule.txt'.
